ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 180-B in the
area bound by:

The alley next north of and parallel to East 75'* Street; a line 54.7 feet west of
and parallel to South Oglesby Avenue; East 75" Street; and, a line 133.9 feet
west of and parallel to South Oglesby Avenue

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
